summary: Iteration 10 validates the three new features: (1) Emergent Object Storage persistence, (2) 'auto' chat model auto-switch, and (3) POST /api/chat/upload photo sharing. Backend: 11/11 pytest passed in /app/backend/tests/test_upload_storage_auto.py — GET /api/chat/models returns exactly 4 catalog items with index 0 being {provider:auto, model:auto, name:'Auto · Elena elige'}; POST /api/chat/model with {provider:auto, model:auto} returns 200 and persists chat_provider/chat_model in db.users; POST /api/chat/stream with user.chat_provider='auto' streams >=1 delta + event:done for both a SHORT message ('ja jaja' → routed to gemini-3-flash-preview by _auto_pick) and a LONG emotional message (routed to gemini-3.1-pro-preview) within <15s each; /api/chat/upload returns 401 without auth, 422 with no file field, 400 with detail 'Solo fotos, mi amor.' for text/plain files, and 200 for a valid 4x4 PNG (generated via struct+zlib) with the exact response shape: user_message.role='user', text='(te compartí una foto)', attachment_type='image', attachment_url starts with '/api/storage/elena-lounge/', plus message_id/user_id/created_at; both user_message and elena_message are persisted in db.chat_messages; /api/storage/{path} returns 401 without auth and 200 with Content-Type image/png and non-empty body (73 bytes echoed back exactly) with valid session — verified via BOTH the freshly-uploaded chat path AND a manually-seeded media_jobs storage_path (proving the regression contract for /api/media/generate-photo). Frontend (Playwright, seeded session cookie on /dashboard): all critical selectors present — chat-upload-button (ImagePlus icon), chat-upload-input (hidden file input), chat-mic-button, chat-send-button, chat-clear-button, voice-selector-trigger, voice-toggle-button, wa-call-button, chat-model-selector-trigger. Model selector opens to reveal exactly 4 options including data-testid='chat-model-selector-option-auto-auto' with label 'Auto · Elena elige' and its vibe/description block. Simulating page.set_input_files on chat-upload-input with a 73-byte PNG fires exactly 1 POST /api/chat/upload; on success the chat gains 2 new bubbles (user + elena) — the user bubble renders an whose src is REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL + '/api/storage/elena-lounge//upload/upload_*.png' via mediaApi.fileUrl, and the sonner toast 'Elena está viendo tu foto 💋' is shown. Full end-to-end 3-feature integration confirmed.

minor.issue: OpenAI GPT-5.4 currently returns 409 'Daily spend limit reached' (external quota on EMERGENT_LLM_KEY today). The Elena upload-reaction call catches the exception and gracefully returns fallback text 'Mmm mi amor, no me llegó bien tu foto… mándame otra 💋' (still >5 chars so contract holds). Not a code bug — external quota. Consider using _auto_pick / Gemini fallback inside chat_upload so quota exhaustion on GPT-5.4 doesn't degrade the photo-reaction copy.

action_items: OPTIONAL: In /api/chat/upload, when GPT-5.4 send_message throws (e.g. 409 daily_limit_reached), retry once via gemini-3-flash-preview before falling back to canned string — otherwise on quota-exhaustion days users see a generic 'no me llegó bien tu foto' instead of a real reaction.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L143-153 _resolve_chat_model correctly short-circuits on provider=='auto' → _auto_pick(text). The heuristic keyword lists (_AUTO_FLASH_HINTS / _AUTO_PRO_HINTS) are Spanish-first and case-insensitive; the len(<30) short-message rule catches 'ja jaja' before the substring check.

server.py L469-545 chat_upload: excellent input validation order (empty→400, >20MB→413, non-image→400 with exact 'Solo fotos, mi amor.' detail), correct storage.build_path namespacing (elena-lounge/<uid>/upload/upload_<12hex>.<ext>), and both user_msg and elena_msg are persisted BEFORE returning — no orphan writes if LLM fails. Response strips _id via dict comprehension.

server.py L521 chat_upload intentionally hardcodes DEFAULT_CHAT_PROVIDER/DEFAULT_CHAT_MODEL (openai/gpt-5.4) for the reaction rather than honoring the user's chat_provider. Comment explains 'send_message compatibility varies across providers.' Reasonable, but during quota outages on OpenAI it degrades — see action item.

server.py L771-780 /api/storage/{path:path} uses Starlette wildcard, requires auth for every fetch (private-by-default), returns Cache-Control private/max-age=300, and 404s on any storage.get_object exception. Solid.
server.py L577-580 and L637-640 photo/video generation gracefully catch storage.put_object failure and fall back to disk (MEDIA_DIR) — good defensive coding for a new persistence layer.
storage_client.py L38-56 put_object retries once with init_storage(force=True) on 403/404 — handles transient storage-key expiry. Same pattern in get_object.

ChatPanel.jsx L302-327 handleFileChosen: client-side pre-validation (image/* + 20MB) matches server-side; resets input.value before await so the same file can be re-picked; disables sending during upload; toast success/error copy is user-friendly.
ChatPanel.jsx L384-390 renders for messages with attachment_type='image' — correctly prepends REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL to the /api/storage/... path so browser routes through auth-cookie-carrying origin.
Regression: server.py stays at 1249 lines. The earlier recommendation to split routers per feature (chat/media/storage/whatsapp) remains a nice-to-have but not blocking.
